# Test components that appear within a line of text.

md2html -html output -html-ext html testsite
exists output/README.html

# A badge renders inside the paragraph, not as a block of its own.
grep '<p>Status: <span class="md-badge" data-color="green"' output/README.html
grep '>stable</span> and' output/README.html

# The body between the tags keeps its Markdown meaning.
grep '<strong>bold</strong></span>' output/README.html

# Boolean attributes are read as booleans, not as non-empty strings.
grep 'data-stroke="true"' output/README.html

# Tooltips use the title attribute, so the hint needs no JavaScript.
grep '<span class="md-tooltip" title="a hint">this phrase</span>' output/README.html

# Prose that merely looks like a tag produces no component diagnostics.
# Goldmark still drops <String> as raw HTML, which is its long-standing
# behavior for unsafe HTML and not something components change.
grep '<p>Generic types like List' output/README.html
! stderr 'components: parse error'

rm -rf testsite output

# Misuse of a registered component is still reported.
md2html -html output -html-ext html badsite
exists output/README.html

stderr 'components: parse error'
stderr 'missing required attribute'
stderr 'must stand alone on its own line'

rm -rf badsite output

-- testsite/README.md --
# Inline

Status: <Badge color="green">stable</Badge> and <Badge stroke>**bold**</Badge>.

Hover <Tooltip tip="a hint">this phrase</Tooltip> for detail.

Generic types like List<String> and <PLACEHOLDER> stay as written.

-- badsite/README.md --
# Bad

Hover <Tooltip>no tip</Tooltip> here.

A card <Card title="x"/> in a sentence.
